name: io.github.teslajoy/omicstra
description: Cross-modal reasoning for spatial biology. Exposes fixed scientific protocols as tools and returns evidence JSON; the client holds the model. Routes a question to a method from a cohort's own recorded evaluation, and refuses when that evidence is absent rather than inheriting another cohort's winner.

environmentVariables.name: OMICSTRA_PROJECT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: The cohort directory. This is BOTH the cohort selector and the security boundary - nothing outside it is addressable, and passing a project_id that names a different cohort raises rather than silently serving this one.

environmentVariables.name: OMICSTRA_CHECKPOINT
environmentVariables.description: memory | sqlite:<path>. The admissibility gate is an interrupt; resuming it after the process exits needs a durable saver. memory is fine for one interactive session.

environmentVariables.name: REQUIRE_PROTOCOL_2026
environmentVariables.description: 0 | 1. Refuse clients older than the 2026-07-28 protocol revision. Set to 1 behind an authorization server: older clients cannot present audience-bound tokens.

environmentVariables.name: OMICSTRA_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: http transport only. The hostname the server is REACHED at - the transport refuses an unknown Host (DNS-rebinding protection, on by default). Behind a gateway this is the gateway's hostname, not the instance's.

remotes.description: Stateless by design - any instance handles any request, because the run handle is a run_id passed as an ordinary parameter rather than a session. Set OMICSTRA_TRANSPORT=http. A public deployment substitutes its own URL.

io.github.teslajoy/omicstra.note: The server executes nothing a model wrote. A model has three narrow jobs, all client-side: classify a question into a closed task set, choose among enumerated options at a gate, and write the rationale. Every consequence resolves from lookup tables, so swapping the model cannot change a route.
io.github.teslajoy/omicstra.humanInTheLoop: The admissibility gate raises an interrupt carrying its full record set, so a client is never asked to accept cautions without seeing the diagnostics behind them. A client that cannot surface an interrupt cannot complete a gated protocol.
io.github.teslajoy/omicstra.dataClassification: Declared per cohort and defaulting to restricted, so a missing declaration fails closed. Public cohorts additionally require provenance - a redistribution claim with no source is not checkable.
